name: DicePrimeBot
description: A composite assistant that orchestrates tasks to roll dice (using its local 'roll_agent') and check prime numbers (using a remote 'prime_agent'). It serves as the main command router for both functionalities.

skills.name: Dice and Prime Orchestrator
skills.description: Processes complex requests, coordinating the dice rolling tool/agent and the remote prime checking agent.

skills.name: Dice Rolling Service
skills.description: Direct service for rolling a die of any specified size.

skills.name: Prime Number Checker
skills.description: Verifies if an integer is a prime number by delegating to an external A2A service.
